text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Um.
I'm... sticking out like a sore thumb, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to feel kinda embarrassed...
Do I stand out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Because cute plushies and stuff aren't really my style... Could I get a bag?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Cute stuffed animals don't really suit me anyway.
I should probably ask for a bag, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! Talk about a lazy comment.
...Well, it'd be a waste of the bag anyway, so... fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! R-Really?
In that case, maybe I'll carry it home in my arms...♪
